note: No fact: the Director General describes WAPIS as giving units consultation and the feeding of a database of wanted persons, weapons, vehicles, identity documents and suspect, lost or reported objects, which the typology classes as identification; the document does not say stations enter complaints or cases in it. The parent may weigh the 62 connected sub-stations (47 police, 11 gendarmerie, 4 customs; no total of stations given) against that class. The eighteen other systems are listed as in use or in advanced development, with no description beyond their names.
